policy.purpose: Provenance-preserving retention plan for superseded dated report artifacts.
policy.before_removal: Every removed path needs a reviewed entry with its original generation time, content hash, and durable replacement location.
policy.pages_projection: Current browser and visual QA manifests remain on Pages; visual-QA screenshot binaries remain committed in GitHub with manifest paths and SHA-256 digests, but are excluded from the bounded Pages artifact rather than pruned.
